verdict.rationale: The only many-items-at-once capability evidenced is read-side: list endpoints return whole collections such as stakeholders, option grants and convertible notes, and the Data Warehouse supports multi-faceted SQL queries across unified fund and portfolio data. The only documented write is creating a single draft option grant, with no batch variant. Missing for 10: bulk create/update/delete endpoints, batch job or async bulk processing documentation, bulk actions via the MCP plugins, and any hands-on corroboration.
